segments.text: A girl who lives in the same boarding house, Oasis, as Yosuke and the first witch he meets. Being a carefree girl, Ayari never cares about trivial things and just always goes with the flow.
The second witch Yosuke meets and the ojou-sama of the school. Due to her serious personality, she gives off an unapproachable aura. Suzuno is also very proud of her existence as a witch.
Yosuke's older-sister like childhood friend who is 2 years older. She is originally from England.
The third witch Yosuke meets, she is his senpai by one year. She always tries to help anybody and can't leave a person in need of help alone.

A girl who is always by Misumi's side and claims to ber her magic wand. She only shows her energetic side whenever she's with Misumi, but to other people, she is just a silent and blunt girl. Her favorite pastry is the eclair.
